name: La Romana

queries.query: La Romana Dominican Republic official cadastral map parcel viewer GIS catastro
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Alcaldía de La Romana municipal portal listing Catastro municipal, the Registro Inmobiliario cadastral-parcel consultation entrypoint, the national DGCN virtual office, and the IDERD geographic viewer/geoservice directory. No anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: La Romana República Dominicana mapa catastral parcelas visor oficial catastro
queries.result: La búsqueda en español encontró evidencia oficial del Catastro municipal de la Alcaldía de La Romana, la competencia de la Dirección Regional de Mensuras Catastrales del Departamento Este sobre La Romana, y la Consulta parcelario catastral del Registro Inmobiliario. No se obtuvo una respuesta anónima segura con identidad nativa más geometría de parcela.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Spanish discovery plus bounded official viewer/API inspection
sourceReview: Local/regional custodianship is evidenced: the Alcaldía de La Romana lists Catastro municipal; Registro Inmobiliario identifies the regional cadastral-survey authority whose competence includes La Romana and provides a cadastral-parcel consultation service. DGCN provides national cadastral procedures. The current anonymous parcel viewer/API could not be qualified because the RI service routes returned 503 and IDERD viewer/geoservice requests returned Cloudflare challenge pages.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official municipal portal loaded and lists Catastro municipal among municipal services. No parcel layer, schema, API, or geometry was embedded in the bounded inspection.

Official Registro Inmobiliario page states that the Dirección Regional de Mensuras Catastrales del Departamento Este has competence over La Romana and grants cadastral parcel designations. This is registry/custodian evidence, not parcel geometry.

Official Registro Inmobiliario page loaded and lists La Romana with code LRMN in its cartographic/parcel system material. The linked LRMN PDF is a fixed-point reference document, not a parcel polygon dataset.

Anonymous cadastral-parcel consultation route returned Service Unavailable. No login, credential, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS bypass was attempted. This is an unavailable-route observation only, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Anonymous official property-locator route returned Service Unavailable. No parcel response was obtained; this was not treated as a zero hit or citywide absence.

Official DGCN virtual office loaded and described public cadastral procedures including location by cadastral designation and cadastral registration. It is a transactional/procedural service and did not expose a safe anonymous parcel feature endpoint.
Official IDERD page explains the geographic viewer and points to geoportal.iderd.gob.do, but the direct request returned a Cloudflare challenge page. No challenge was solved or defeated.

Official IDERD directory loaded and documents WMS, WMTS, WFS, and CSW service types. It exposed the public WFS URL https://geoportal.iderd.gob.do/geoserver/ows?request=GetCapabilities&service=wfs&version=2.0.0.

The public WFS capabilities request returned a Cloudflare challenge HTML page instead of XML capabilities. No layer list, schema, CRS, feature request, or geometry was inferred from the challenge page.
